$comment: Public-history register behind Part V of the thesis and its dated-timeline figure. Events from the 2026-07-31 external X-evidence audit (blind archaeology + lead reconciliation), operator-commissioned; artifact grades A–E per that audit's standard. Prose claims only what these receipts support. Refreshing is a reviewed action, never part of a build.

independencePolicy.rule: Only unsolicited-unaffiliated observations count toward any candidacy pass condition. Operator, related-party, paid, prompted, and coordinated activity is recorded and excluded. Prompted mentions are recorded as prompted.

events.summary: All twelve mints created; origin receipts published in the registry disclosure.
Public trading documented from the day after origin by unaffiliated traders posting rankings and commentary.
events.proves: The records were publicly discoverable and traded.
events.doesNotProve: Independent thesis adoption or durable demand.

events.summary: Public holder-clustering criticism within the first two weeks; answered publicly by the affiliated project account. Both sides preserved.
events.proves: Early adverse scrutiny existed and was answered on the record.
events.doesNotProve: Resolution of concentration; current values live in the instrument.

events.summary: During the news cycle around an unrelated token also named Libra, a widely followed account bought the registry-listed Libra mint by mistake, called it the wrong token and a meme headed to zero, and later framed the purchase in astrology terms.
events.proves: A high-visibility accidental entry, with its unflattering framing.
events.doesNotProve: Deliberate support, sustained holding, or demand.

events.summary: During low-attention stretches, outside commentary publicly called the position a dead bag. Preserved as adverse evidence.
events.proves: Quiet periods were visible to outsiders and said so.

events.summary: The earliest affiliated language around the tokens was memecoin voice ('own your sign', investment slogans). The registry register — receipts, criteria, disclosures — arrived later, with zodiacs.org. Both eras archived.
events.proves: The sales voice predates the registry voice.

events.summary: Registry, disclosures, candidacy scoreboard, and preregistered test published with dated values.
events.proves: That the registry, disclosures and scoreboard were published with dated values on this date.
events.doesNotProve: Independent adoption; the scoreboard carries those readings.
